confirm.text: These are selections on the air job observation multi-select, reported so the technicians can confirm what they meant. They are not confirmed events. One point stands out today: "Stop work authority utilized" was not selected on any form. Every form that touched the stop-work items chose "Stop work authority was discussed", which is the routine pre-job item.
Selected "Unsafe conditions" together with "Stop work authority was discussed":

1099 Kedrick McCarter — XTO, TXL 33 Unit 1 4014AH, job 37236, ended 10:09 AM. The only narrative is "Bleeding the well so they can disconnect for upcoming workover". No description of an unsafe condition anywhere on the form.

1099 Kedrick McCarter — XTO, Kyle 2600 Unit 2 2625SH, job 37238, ended 4:52 PM. The only narrative is "No near miss, a reconnect on a well". No description of an unsafe condition anywhere on the form.

One of these is not the mis-selection pattern. 1099 Alfredo Vaquera — XTO, Cass Countiss 20G 7H, job 37240, ended 10:15 AM — also selected "Unsafe conditions", but his narrative names the condition and how it was controlled: "Very well use of life-saving rules on the Crew wow forklift in motion Crew utilized great communication with Driver and tagline". That reads as a hazard identified and managed, not an uncontrolled condition. It should be treated as a genuine observation rather than a carried-forward tick.

A selection being carried forward. McCarter's two forms above carry an identical observation set, identical "what went well" set, and word-for-word identical close-out text on both jobs ("The job was completed and everyone was efficient in their task at hand..." and "Communicate better" / "Picked up trash"). That pattern suggests the selections were repeated rather than made fresh for the second job. This is the training point Kelby raised on 09/23/2026.

Selected "Stop work authority was discussed" with no unsafe-conditions item — routine, listed for completeness: 1099 Benjamin Boutte (Rocker B, 37213), Dawson Drake (Rocker B, 37212), Bryan Medlin (Locklar Holiman 37241, Turner E41C 37243), 1099 Justin Fontenot (Locklar Holiman 37242, Turner E41C 37244), 1099 Bobby Galindo (Windham R #3, 36970), Alexander Clubb (Pembrook A115, 37124), 1099 Gael Antonio Avila (Pembrook A115, 37125), Jerry Gonzales (Cass Countiss, 37239).

61 of 61 submissions read. The job board was available: the 11/23/2026 ArkLaTex and Permian Basin boards sent by Blake Walton at 10:06 AM were used, and 41 manned board rows were checked for coverage — 30 on the Permian Basin board and 11 on the ArkLaTex board. This run started at 11:06 PM Central, before the Central day closed, so any form submitted after that time is not in the counts; missing Trailer Readiness Forms are the finding most often resolved by a late submission, and the overnight and next-morning arrivals could not be checked at all.
